source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: DYJ 30 May 1927 p8: 'There was only one contest in Limavady rural district, that being in the Straw electoral division ... Mr. Robert Douglas 113, Mr. Samuel Jackson 100'. Labels (U.) from the nominations (BNL 22 Apr 1927 p12; BNL 29 Apr 1927 p7).

note: Triennial election of Limavady rural district (23 divisions, one member each). Seventeen nominations were received for sixteen divisions; the seven divisions with no nomination (Ballyhargan, Ballykelly, Bellarena, Benone, Drum, Faughanvale and Killywool) had their retiring members deemed re-elected (Belfast News-Letter, 22 and 29 April 1927), but those members are not named in the reports read; three are recorded from reports of the new council's meetings (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Straw was the only contest. Polled Friday 27 May 1927: 'Polling took place yesterday in the Bellarena division of county Londonderry, the only division in the county where there was a contest' for the county council (Londonderry Sentinel, Saturday 28 May 1927, p. 8), and the Limavady rural contest in Straw 'took place on Friday' (Derry Journal, 30 May 1927, p. 8). Jackson was the old member; Douglas a new nominee of the Burnfoot branch of the Ulster Farmers' Union. The results line prints no labels; both are (U.) in the nominations.
